title: Cronkeyshaw Common bonfire and fireworks tonight: road closures and parking restrictions around Syke
excerpt: Rochdale's free council bonfire and fireworks display runs from 6pm to 10pm tonight at Cronkeyshaw Common, with roads closed and waiting banned on nearby streets.
body:
Rochdale's free bonfire and fireworks display takes place on Cronkeyshaw Common in Syke tonight, Wednesday 4 November, from 6pm to 10pm.

The event is the last of three organised by Rochdale Borough Council this week, following displays in Middleton on Monday and Heywood on Tuesday. Entry is free and there is no need to book.

The bonfire will be lit at 7pm. A reduced-noise fireworks display set to music begins at 7.30pm, according to the council.

There is no parking on site, and the council has put temporary road closures and parking restrictions in place around the common between 4pm and 9pm.

The following roads are closed to vehicles during that time, with no signed diversion:

Greenbank Road, between Whitworth Road and Eva Street.

Dewhirst Road, between Greenbank Road and Binns Nook Road.

Fieldhouse Road, for its entire length.

Joy Street, between Fieldhouse Road and Isabella Street.

Binns Nook Road, between Fieldhouse Road and Dewhirst Road.

No waiting or loading is allowed on:

Fieldhouse Road, for its entire length.

Binns Nook Road, between Joy Street and Dewhirst Road.

The southern side of Mizzy Road, between Whitworth Road and Heights Lane.

The eastern side of Heights Lane, between Mizzy Road and Quarry Street.

Further Heights Road, between Mizzy Road and Whitehall Street.

Whitehall Street, between Further Heights Road and Quarry Street.

The council is asking people to walk or use public transport where they can, and to be considerate of residents if they park on surrounding streets.

Food and soft drinks will be on sale. No alcohol will be sold, and visitors must not bring their own alcohol, fireworks or sparklers. There are no toilets on site. The council says the event is wheelchair-accessible.

Outdoor events can change at short notice, particularly in poor weather, so check the council's event page before setting off.

Are you heading to Cronkeyshaw tonight, or does the event affect your street? Let us know in the comments.
